# #2109: Patch: named layers, corner radii and shadow depths, and gradients only where they mean something
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

Corner radii, stacking order, shadows and gradients are each chosen one at a time, and nearly every surface has a gradient and a soft shadow. That is a well-known look of generated UI, and when everything is raised nothing stands out. Give the board a few named radii, named layers for what sits above what, a few shadow depths, and keep gradients for the places they mean something (cards, the main button, the table). Everything else goes flat.

### Acceptance

- The board uses named radii, layers and shadow depths.
- Gradients appear only where they mean something.
- What sits on top of what on the board is unchanged.
